content: DuckDB-Wasm (@duckdb/duckdb-wasm) latest stable is v1.33.x (npm dist-tag versions realigned to track DuckDB core ~1.3/1.4 series since v1.29). Ships three bundle variants: mvp (Wasm 1.0 baseline), eh (Wasm 1.0 + exception handling, faster, still single-threaded), and a threaded/pthreads bundle requiring SharedArrayBuffer. selectBundle() auto-picks the best bundle the browser+environment supports; the threaded bundle is only offered when the page is cross-origin-isolated (crossOriginIsolated===true), otherwise it silently falls back to eh/mvp (single-threaded, still fully functional for querying Parquet). Vite integration uses '?url' imports for the .wasm/worker assets (e.g. import duckdb_wasm from '@duckdb/duckdb-wasm/dist/duckdb-mvp.wasm?url').
